rows.text: You are in a vast grassland and the sky is speckled with clouds. Everything is a "pixel" drawing. You look down at your hands and find them to be pixelated cubes.
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: You are wearing a pixel watch on your wrist. With your pixelated thumb, you press down on the watch. With a bang, your clothes change into overalls.
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: You stare at the pixel blocks floating in the air as vintage electronic music plays in the background. A group of pixel ants crawls on the ground in a formation that reads, "Welcome, Mr. Jibaou the radish."
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: The ants quickly form several pixel characters that read, "That's you!" You decide to ignore the ants. On a pixel cloud that drifts in your direction, you see some words written with crayons: "Produced by Herta."
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: You realize you've been attacked by the Curio "Dice of Dimensionality Reduction." You are now a part of the graffiti — casually drawn by Herta with crayons — on the wall of the Simulated Universe.
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: You kick a brick in exasperation, and a pixel Gold Coin emerges.
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: You want to figure out how to get back to the Simulated Universe. You may climb out from the pipe on your left, or hop onto the brick on your right.
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: Climb into the pipes to the left.
You have eaten a Gold Coin left behind by a Trailblazer. The Gold Coin splits into two, then into four. It constantly divides and proliferates... giving you a surprising windfall.
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: You run into a brawny man from Wildfire who looks out of place with the artstyle of this world. He strikes a boxing pose and yells "KO!" Unfortunately, you fail to dodge his punch.
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: You proceed and see a pixel question mark on which you hang your hat. Obviously, this is a save point. You can continue the game later.
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe
